hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A bishop moves diagonally, keeping the color parity of its square invariant.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If the source and destination squares have different parity, reaching the target is impossible.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether source and destination lie on the same diagonal; if so, only one move is required, otherwise two moves suffice.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Parity check and diagonal comparison run in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Board search is unnecessary due to closed-form geometry.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Observes color invariance and diagonal geometry directly.
